user.title: Connect IntiHA
user.description: The IntiHA Engine app is normally found automatically. For an engine running elsewhere, enter its address below. Supported Bluetooth devices connect automatically when powered on.

data_description.engine_url: Enter a host name or IP address, for example 192.168.0.10. A full ws:// or wss:// bridge URL also works.

hassio_confirm.title: IntiHA is ready
hassio_confirm.description: Connect to the IntiHA Engine app? Supported devices will connect automatically when powered on. You can turn IntiHA off at any time with its Enabled switch.

error.invalid_url: Enter a host name, IP address, or ws:// or wss:// URL ending in /bridge, without credentials, a query, or a fragment.

abort.already_configured: IntiHA is already configured. Use its options to change settings.
abort.invalid_discovery: The IntiHA Engine app sent an invalid address. Restart the app or add IntiHA manually using its address.

data_description.engine_url: Enter a host name or IP address, for example 192.168.0.10. A full ws:// or wss:// bridge URL also works.

data_description.control_timeout: Home Assistant movement commands expire after this time without a new movement command. External clients use their own negotiated heartbeat.
data_description.auto_reconnect: Reconnect a device if its connection drops, using an available active Bluetooth proxy. New supported devices always connect automatically.

error.invalid_url: Enter a host name, IP address, or ws:// or wss:// URL ending in /bridge, without credentials, a query, or a fragment.

stop_all.name: Stop all
stop_all.description: Attempt to stop all reachable IntiHA devices. A disconnected device cannot receive a stop command.

scan.name: Search devices
scan.description: Refresh discovery and retry supported Bluetooth devices. New compatible devices also connect automatically while IntiHA is enabled.

reconnect.name: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Stop reachable devices and create a fresh engine connection. No movement values are replayed.
